Cross-ref (BBC): https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c89nxj4d5pqo
NOTE (Wed 22 Jul) — New Defence Secretary Wes Streeting apologised after a hot-mic at a Cabinet drinks (Tue) caught him joking about the early-release scheme to Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood on seeing new Justice Secretary Alex Norris: Streeting — "You know he's the enemy now, Justice Shabana?... He wants to let them all out." Streeting on X: "I hope everyone can see there was no ill intent behind this ribbing of the new Justice Secretary — it was a reference to an old May/Clarke joke. But I appreciate these are very serious issues and am sorry for any offence inadvertently caused by this moment of levity." Streeting also insisted there was "no ill intent". Burnham, asked if it was acceptable for Cabinet to joke about early release: "No, it's not, and certainly that's been acknowledged, and apologies have been made." (Footage via Metro/Guido — non-approved; facts confirmed by Independent + BBC, both approved.)
Separately (Independent live blog) Streeting at Farnborough air show unveiled BAE Systems' Lancashire-built uncrewed 'loyal wingman' jet "Brontanax" (in the air 2027), backed Trump's call for Europe to spend more on defence — "President Trump has called on Europe to carry a greater share of the burden for our own defence, and he is right to do so."
